title: Act: Write a report from Runner.Run for every outcome
description: Add Reporter interface and SetReporter, wrap Run so a report is written after any run that acquired the lock.
acceptance_criteria: Report written on FAILED, AWAITING_APPROVAL and COMPLETED

steps.action: Add interface Reporter{ Write(report.Report) error }, field reporter Reporter on Runner, and method SetReporter(rep Reporter) assigning it; import internal/report
steps.expected: Runner can hold a reporter; nil means no reports

steps.action: Rename the existing Run body to run(ctx,id,roundID). Add new Run that records start:=r.now(), calls run, and if the returned execution has ID "" (lock failure) returns unchanged; otherwise if r.reporter!=nil builds report.Report from e (ExecutionID,RoundID,Status,Attempts,Error from e.Error or err.Error() when empty, StartedAt start, FinishedAt r.now(), DurationMS) and calls Write; if Write errors and err==nil return e and the wrapped error 'runner: write report: %w'
steps.expected: A report is written on every branch after the lock is taken
